segments.text: Human class.
A kind-hearted girl who loves her mother more than anyone.
As a child, she suffered terribly at the hands of a witch who came to her village.
Ever since, she's harbored an intense hatred toward witches.
Still, in order to earn the reward money that's needed to get her beloved mother into a good hospital, she decides to enroll in Lilac Academy—the very place where the witches she despises reside.
Witch class.
The first student in history who's repeating a year at Lilac Academy.
Normally, students are expelled if they're unable to pass their finals, but since Henri is from an especially distinguished family, an exception was made to give her a second chance.
She's cheerful and friendly, and she doesn't sweat the small stuff—a trait typical of witches.
Even though she often fails when casting spells, she never doubts that she'll succeed next time.
While Henri uses her magic with the best intentions, she often accidentally ends up causing headaches for Emil.
From the official website
Human class.
A caring and considerate girl the whole human class looks up to as a leader.
Trusted even by the professors, Lyla is a rare model student among an academy full of misfits.
While she's of the highest social standing in the human class, she never flaunts her status and treats everybody as equals.
She shares a dorm room with Emil and is her closest confidant.
Witch class.
Patollo's introverted personality and negative way of thinking has earned her the reputation of the most unwitchlike witch at the academy.
Her cowardice and overly dramatic reactions tend to be a source of amusement for the other witches, and they often tease and play pranks on her.
She tries her best not to make others uncomfortable, but her attempts often miss their mark, so saying "sorry" has become second nature to her.
Human class.
A quiet girl with a mature aura about her.
She cares about her friends and never hesitates to help when she sees someone struggling.
Despite her calm and cool demeanor, she can actually be quite clumsy. She sometimes misinterprets what others are saying and ends up doing some very strange things as a result.
Witch class.
Violet has an especially strong sense of pride and an obsession with becoming the best at everything.
When she becomes too focused on her goals, she loses sight of her surroundings and fails to achieve the desired results.

Violet highly respects her father, a politician who looks down on ordinary people—especially humans. Because she was raised with those beliefs, she considers the human class students unworthy of her grace.
Human class.
An extremely strong girl who's able to take on a wild boar with her bare hands.
She has trouble controlling her power—her vise-grip handshake has resulted in many broken bones.
Lynn doesn't dwell on her mistakes and tries to forget them as soon as possible, which often leads her to make the same mistakes again.
However, her classmates still love her for her energetic and friendly nature.
Witch class.
A girl who loves good food and always seems to be hungry.
Cooking is her specialty, and she often cooks or bakes treats for her dormmates.
Sometimes her food pairings are a bit questionable, but the witch class students don't seem to mind and will happily eat anything Aether makes.
She's kind and tends to prioritize others' needs above her own, but this doesn't bother her at all.
Human class.
A painfully shy girl. She ends up stuttering more often than not, so she usually ends up saying nothing.
Nobody in her class has ever heard her speak up.
However, it's not as if Noa dislikes her classmates. In fact, she was kind enough to lend Emil her notes when she joined the class a week late.
Her grades are among the highest at the academy, and she never forgets anything she reads or hears.
Witch class.
A fun-loving girl who loves to play pranks with her twin sister Pioni, another student in the witch class.
Student or professor, nobody is safe from the twins' mischief.
Sometimes they get scolded for taking their pranks too far, but Vivi is quick to forget the consequences. She enjoys their victims' reactions far too much to quit.
Human class.
The biggest witchaholic in the whole academy, she knows more about witches than anybody else. Ask her a single question, and she's able to ramble for hours on the subject.
She can get rash whenever witches are concerned. She's often found sneaking into the library in search of more knowledge or peeking into the witch class's dormitory.
Witch class.
A fun-loving girl who loves to play pranks with her twin sister Vivi, another student in the witch class.
Student or professor, nobody is safe from the twins' mischief.
Sometimes they get scolded for taking their pranks too far, but since Pioni doesn't think they did anything wrong, she'll already be thinking about what they're going to do next.
The human class's homeroom teacher.
Ever serious, she teaches her students with a strict hand.
Garcia and Love are old friends, and Garcia often finds herself at the mercy of Love's whimsies. However, she knows that Love is incorrigible and has more or less accepted her fate.
The witch class' homeroom teacher.
Befitting of her moniker, "The Witch of Passion," her hobby is talking about all things l-o-v-e.
Love has a vivid imagination and tends to jump to conclusions whenever her old buddy Garcia is concerned.
She prefers for her students to call her "Miss Love" rather than "Professor Love."
The potions teacher.
Born out of the union between a human and a witch, she suffers from a weak constitution and often looks pale.
She used to work odd jobs at Lilac Academy, which led to her becoming friends with academy students Garcia and Love.
After receiving recommendations from her friends, who had both become professors, she officially became a faculty member.
Vlad was once a member of the Lilac Spell Corps and is known as a living legend among witch fans.
As her moniker, "The Witch of Blood," implies, she's famed for the fierce battles she fought while in active service.
She became a professor at Lilac Academy after retiring and now dedicates herself to training the next generation.
Her harsh training methods stem from the kindness of her heart. All she wants is for her students to survive when they join the Spell Corps.
Wizard class.
